Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Parent] AS IIf([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Parent IS NULL, "none", [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Parent.UniqueName) SELECT {[Measures].[Parent]} ON 0, {[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[All Diagnoses by ICD-10 Chapter], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS].[J06], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[REST_H], [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].[RESPIRATORY].[UPPER_RESPIRATORY_INFECTIONS].[J06].Parent, [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[DIAGNOSES].Parent} ON 1 FROM [ZCLVISIT]
